passages.text: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He is worthy of praise.
My soul, praise the LORD.
Hallelujah!
passages.original: הַֽלְלוּ־ יָ֡הּ הַלְלִ֥י נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
passages.sermon:
I will praise the LORD.
I will do this all my life.
I will sing praises to my God.
I will sing while I have my being.
passages.original: אֲהַלְלָ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּחַיָּ֑י אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה לֵֽאלֹהַ֣י בְּעוֹדִֽי׃

passages.text: Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.
passages.sermon:
Do not trust in princes.
Do not trust in powerful people.
Do not trust in any human being.
No human can save you.
Only God can save.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּבְטְח֥וּ בִנְדִיבִ֑ים בְּבֶן־ אָדָ֓ם׀ שֶׁ֤אֵֽין ל֥וֹ תְשׁוּעָֽה׃

passages.text: When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.
passages.sermon:
A mortal man cannot save.
A mortal man will die.
When his spirit leaves, he returns to the ground.
On that same day, all his plans end.
passages.original: תֵּצֵ֣א ר֭וּחוֹ יָשֻׁ֣ב לְאַדְמָת֑וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַ֝ה֗וּא אָבְד֥וּ עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God, the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them. He remains faithful forever.
passages.sermon:
The God of Jacob helps some people.
These people are blessed.
They put their hope in the LORD.
The LORD is their God.
The LORD made heaven and earth.
He made the sea.
He made everything in the sea.
The LORD always keeps the truth.
He remains faithful forever.
passages.original: אַשְׁרֵ֗י שֶׁ֤אֵ֣ל יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּעֶזְר֑וֹ שִׂ֝בְר֗וֹ עַל־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃ עֹשֶׂ֤ה׀ שָׁ֘מַ֤יִם וָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־ הַיָּ֥ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֑ם הַשֹּׁמֵ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת לְעוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free, the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Jacob.
The LORD is just.
He gives justice to people who are oppressed.
He gives food to people who are hungry.
The LORD sets prisoners free.
The LORD opens the eyes of people who are blind.
The LORD lifts up people who are weighed down.
The LORD loves people who do what is right.
passages.original: עֹשֶׂ֤ה מִשְׁפָּ֨ט׀ לָעֲשׁוּקִ֗ים נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לָרְעֵבִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה מַתִּ֥יר אֲסוּרִֽים׃ יְהוָ֤ה׀ פֹּ֘קֵ֤חַ עִוְרִ֗ים יְ֭הוָה זֹקֵ֣ף כְּפוּפִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֹהֵ֥ב צַדִּיקִֽים׃

passages.text: The LORD protects foreigners; He sustains the fatherless and the widow, but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.
passages.sermon:
The LORD protects foreigners.
The LORD sustains the fatherless.
The LORD sustains the widow.
The LORD frustrates the ways of the wicked.
passages.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ שֹׁ֘מֵ֤ר אֶת־ גֵּרִ֗ים יָת֣וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֣ה יְעוֹדֵ֑ד וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים יְעַוֵּֽת׃

passages.text: The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Hallelujah!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD rules forever.
The LORD is your God, O Zion.
The LORD rules through every generation.
Praise the LORD!
passages.original: יִמְלֹ֤ךְ יְהוָ֨ה׀ לְעוֹלָ֗ם אֱלֹהַ֣יִךְ צִ֭יּוֹן לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֗ר הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
